quality.intent: Correctness, bounded resource use, failure containment and traceable diagnostics.

criteria.requirement: Memory ownership and bounded allocation behavior remain explicit.
criteria.verification: Memory regression tests exercise the memory subsystem.

criteria.requirement: Governance and safety policies reject invalid or unsafe operations before side effects.
criteria.verification: Governance tests cover policy decisions and failure paths.

criteria.requirement: Diagnostic and measurement output is attributable to the operation that produced it.
criteria.verification: Engineering foundation tests cover diagnostic and trace contracts.

multiplicity.intent: Repeated pipelines and improvement cycles are deterministic where feasible, bounded and auditable.

criteria.requirement: Pipeline stages expose consistent ordering and explicit outcomes.
criteria.verification: Improvement tests exercise the pipeline and its repeatable stages.

criteria.requirement: Evolution steps are represented as explicit, regression-testable changes.
criteria.verification: Evolution tests protect repeatable evolution behavior.

criteria.requirement: Composed multi-stage work defines bounded inputs, per-stage failure reporting and replayable evidence.
criteria.verification: Autoforge and improvement tests provide the extension point; batch limits remain an acceptance item.

native.intent: The primary C11 and processor-facing paths stay direct, portable and testable.

criteria.requirement: Core behavior remains available through the native C11 build without a mandatory managed-runtime layer.
criteria.verification: The core target builds through CMake and is covered by core tests.

criteria.requirement: Processor discovery and bounded benchmark workloads remain in the native C11 path.
criteria.verification: Core regression tests cover processor discovery, bounded benchmark execution and the repeated suite.

criteria.requirement: Embedded integration uses a defined C boundary and has an independently tested lifecycle.
criteria.verification: Embedded tests cover the boundary and lifecycle behavior.
